headline: UK Rent Growth Forecast to Outpace Home Purchase Prices Through 2029
summary: Rents on newly agreed lets in Britain are projected to increase by 14.2% by 2029, growing twice as fast as buying costs due to property shortages and high tenant demand.
why: Hamptons is a British estate agency network that produces housing market research and forecasts.

impacts.name: UK Residential Real Estate
impacts.why: Supply shortages and strong demand are expected to push rental prices up 14.2% over the next several years.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
